LESSON: GROWTH OF TIMBER TREES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: General
Strand: MATERIALS Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experi
Topic 2.1: Growth of timber trees
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Growth of timber trees, part of MATERIALS Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experi in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 General.

Key inquiry question: Why is the growing of timber trees important in the society? 2. Which are the common species of trees for timber in Kenya?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the process of growing trees for timber production,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Growth of timber trees in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. classify timber trees according to their physical features

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Growth of timber trees in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. illustrate a cross section of a tree trunk

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Growth of timber trees in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Growth of timber trees together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and teamwork skills when brainstorming on the

process of timber tree growth from seed to maturity

• Critical thinking and problem solving: learner develops evaluation and decision making skills when sketching and

labelling parts of a tree trunk

• Learning to learn: learner reflects on own work when preparing a tree nursery within the school compound.

15

Values:
• Responsibility: learner takes care of the tree nurseries within the school compound and monitors their growth.

• Patriotism: learner donates seedlings for environmental conservation.

• Unity: learner takes a walk to the surrounding to observe and classify trees into softwoods or hardwoods.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social cohesion: learner tour and interact with their neighbourhood to observe and classify trees.

• Environmental conservation: learner prepare a tree nursery within the school compound and monitor their growth.

• Road safety: safety awareness on dangers of growing trees near the road .

Suggested Resources: Forest, trees, tactile labels, tactile markers, model of tree trunk,

Key Concepts/Skills:

Classifying timber trees according to their physical features

Illustrating a cross section of a tree trunk
